response.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT s.transref AS transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS base_short
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
)
SELECT tx.transreg, tx.ordertypedist, tx.avg_short, tx.avg_opt,
  tx.avg_short / NULLIF(b.base_short, 0) AS ratio
FROM tx
LEFT JOIN base b ON b.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM tx.ordertypedist
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The baseline is the average of shortintrt over all matched snapshots in the same order type mix (each snapshot weighted equally, NULLs ignored), not an average of per-transaction averages.
If the baseline is zero, the ratio is NULL, so it sorts last. Transactions with a NULL ordertypedist are grouped together as their own mix.
